_doc: D3 — role-binding precedence graph (SP-20260718-001 Phase 0). Machine-readable companion to top-level-runtime-contract.md §3. Consumed today by conformance-matrix.js (Phase-0 kernel fixtures, gate 'role-binding'); Phase-2 G2.1 wires this into the live dispatch/session-bootstrap runtime (ED-216). Gauntlet round 1 fix (Q-1/Q-2): 'sources' is now TOTAL over every 'order' entry except UNBOUND, and key names align with 'order' exactly (sources.helm renamed to sources.explicit_top_level_helm).

explicit_user._meaning: An explicit, in-session user/operator instruction — the OPERATOR's own direct instruction (a trusted human), categorically different from ambient repo prose. Precedence order position #1.

validated_workorder_or_cli._meaning: A validated WorkOrder field or CLI/dispatch binding. 'Validated' means it passed schema validation against workorder-min.schema.json AND arrived via the trusted dispatch bridge (scripts/dispatch-claude.js / scripts/dispatch-agent.js), never a self-asserted claim — see top-level-runtime-contract.md §3 P3.2 (S-2) for the full provenance definition. Precedence order position #2.

explicit_top_level_helm._meaning: An explicit top-level runtime (helm) binding. Precedence order position #3; the ONLY source for the top-level human-facing session default (top_level_default_binding_source = helm_only).

agents_md._meaning: The neutral, provider-neutral handbook every provider auto-loads — ambient prose, NOT an ordered binding source (not in 'order' above). CORE-3: ambient prose can never itself manufacture a binding.

repo_prose._meaning: Any other ambient repository text (stale worktree copies, handoff prompts, etc.) — same CORE-3 refusal as agents_md.

notes.CORE-1: Dispatched workers NEVER default to binding as the President (alex-alpha) when unbound; worker_default_when_unbound = FAIL_CLOSED is the machine-readable form of this invariant.
notes.CORE-3: repo_prose.can_bind = false and agents_md.can_bind = false — neutral, provider-neutral, AMBIENT prose (root AGENTS.md, ambient CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md shims, any stale worktree copy, any handoff prompt) can NEVER manufacture a binding. CORE-3 is a restriction on ambient/neutral PROSE specifically — it is NOT a claim that only a validated WorkOrder/CLI binding or an explicit top-level helm binding can bind a role at all. Per the 'order' above, explicit_user.can_bind = true: the operator's own direct, in-session instruction IS a legitimate binding source (order position #1), categorically different from ambient repo prose. All three of explicit_user, validated_workorder_or_cli, and explicit_top_level_helm can bind; only agents_md and repo_prose (ambient prose) cannot.
notes.top_level_default: The TOP-LEVEL human-facing session defaults to alex-alpha (packet-04 binding order #5), but ONLY via an explicit helm binding (top_level_default_binding_source = helm_only) — never via ambient/neutral prose. This is the RATIFIED-PLAN Phase-2 α ruling: dispatched workers are UNBOUND-fail-closed; the operator's own top-level session is NOT left unbound.

phase_seed: Phase-0 SEED — fixture-proven (unbound-dispatch-fails-closed, no-root-alpha-poison) but not yet wired into the live runtime. See ED-216. Full precedence enforcement lands at RATIFIED-PLAN Phase 2 (G2.1).
